reply_text:
Moss's 30 September digest lists it as support ticket #8841. The digest says Mateo Quiroga submitted it for Vantorre Group (VTG): drivers on the second shift at Newark couldn't select Dock Door 14 on the check-in kiosk. You escalated it to the platform engineering queue.

Before you send it to engineering, check the number. On 1 July you told #strategic-pod that you'd closed #8841 for a different issue, the Detention Summary CSV export and the kiosk browser cache. The digest may have the wrong number, or the number may have been reused. I can't see the ticketing system, so I can't tell which. Please confirm #8841 in the support tool.

The only other Door 14 ticket I can see is INC-4821, from the 3 August Hartford kiosk outage. That ticket is about status-page access and isn't the Newark issue.
